messages.content: Flappy Bird 遊戲中最低的分數是多少？

function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content: 在《Flappy Bird》遊戲裡，得分從 **0** 開始。只要一開始就撞到牆壁或地面，就會立刻結束並保持 0 分，因此「最低可能的分數」就是 **0 分**（沒有負分）。
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Flappy Bird 遊戲中最低的分數是多少?" which translates from Chinese as "What is the lowest score in Flappy Bird game?" They want the minimum possible score? In Flappy Bird, you start at zero and each pipe passed increments your score; so the lowest score would be 0 if you haven't passed any pipes or maybe -1? But typical scoring starts at 0 when you pass first pipe gives +1. So lowest score is 0.

But they might ask about some record low? Or perhaps they mean what is the minimal achievable score? Usually it's 0 because you can die immediately before passing any pipe. There's no negative scores. So answer: 0 points.

We should respond accordingly. No need to call tool. Just give answer.
